annotations.title: Restore a backup to a new server

description: Creates a NEW server from a backup in the backup's city and cloud, billed per hour like any server. Optionally on a bigger plan. Needs confirm: true; without it returns the price. Refused with the price if it costs more than max_hourly_usd (default $1). Sets a new random root password, returned once (it stays in the chat history).

confirm.description: true creates the server; without it the tool only returns the price.

max_hourly_usd.description: Upper bound for the hourly price, default 1.

plan.description: Plan id or name to restore onto; default the backup's own plan. The disk must be at least as big.

name: restore_backup
title: Restore a backup to a new server
